row.proto: int Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceVehicle(void *entrants, uint32_t handle, const void *vehicle)
row.notes: named from its log messages (channel ENTRANTS_SYSTEM): 'Vehicle replaced with stat id %s | Failed to add vehicle with stat id %s whilst replacing' | myteam-heal 2026-11-13: handle = the packed vehicle handle as Sess_ResolveEntityHandle reads it (kind = handle & 0xff, stat id = handle >> 16). Kind 0 (preloaded) is refused with 5 ('Not allowed to replace preloaded vehicle'); a kind whose table [entrants+0x328+kind*0x10] is null returns 1. Otherwise an existing vehicle equal to the source (0x1424f9bf0 on vehicle+0x10) returns 4; 0x142476580(table, id) runs, 0x1424f9310 builds a record on the stack (record+0 = handle, record+0x10.. = a copy of the source, the file_name string at record+0x58 {vt, cap 0x100, ptr, chars at record+0x70}), Sess_VehicleTable_EmplaceAt (0x140cdca10) stores it at slot id (growing the slot vector to id first), 0 from the store returns 3, else it posts message 0x14578d698 and returns 0 when a vehicle was there before, 2 when it was added. The source is vehicle data in the layout of a stored vehicle from +0x10 (ResolveEntityHandle result + 0x10), as Career_MyTeamSetup_CommitTeamIdentity passes it (call 0x140c2e04d). Used by core's My Team vehicle heal to rebuild a My Team (kind 1) vehicle a 1.9.21/1.9.22 load dropped from a stock My Team vehicle.
